subsystem: Zero-Shutter-Lag (ZSL) Circular Ring Buffer Topography & Replay DMA

zsl_ring_buffer_architecture.description: Continuous zero-latency circular frame caching architecture in system DRAM allowing real-time capture of past uncompressed Bayer raw frames upon instant shutter button actuation.

versions_supported.description: Extended 64-bit coherent IOP header with 64-byte cache alignment

fields.name: _flags
fields.description: Buffer allocation flags (cacheability, coherency, locked state)

fields.name: _wrptr
fields.description: Current write pointer byte offset within data buffer

fields.name: _rdptr
fields.description: Current read pointer byte offset within data buffer

fields.name: _size
fields.description: Total allocated data buffer capacity in bytes (dataBufSize)

fields.name: _watermark
fields.description: Low watermark threshold for triggering ring wrap notifications

fields.name: _head_seq
fields.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number of newest frame

fields.name: _tail_seq
fields.description: Sequence number of oldest valid frame currently in buffer

fields.name: _dram_phys_base
fields.description: 64-bit physical address of DRAM ring buffer space

fields.name: _reserved
fields.description: Zero padding to align to 64-byte cache line boundary

fields.name: payloadSize
fields.description: Length of payload frame data in bytes

fields.name: frameTimestampNs
fields.description: 64-bit hardware timestamp from sensor SoC timer

fields.name: exposureType
fields.description: Exposure bracket type (0: EV0, 1: EV-, 2: EV+, 3: Flash)

replay_dma_architecture.hardware_mechanism: Direct SIFDMA (Sensor Interface DMA) multiplexer rerouting
zero_shutter_lag_capture_sequence: 1. User taps shutter button on iOS Camera UI.
2. Host driver issues IOP message freezing write pointer update on current active ring buffer.
3. Driver evaluates metadata headers (sIOPRingBufferMsgHeaderV2_t) to select optimal multi-exposure bracket (typically 1 short, 3 EV0, 1 long frame).
4. Host driver dispatches CISP_CMD_CH_REPLAY_SIFDMA_ENABLE with targeted frame DRAM physical addresses.
5. Silenus SIFDMA switches input multiplexer from live MIPI CSI-2 receivers to DRAM ring buffer replay descriptors.
6. Replayed frames stream into BayerProc and EDemProc as if arriving directly from the sensor in real time.
7. Deep Fusion MSTF pipeline completes multi-frame alignment and neural synthesis with 0ms mechanical shutter lag.
